ui_bugs.issue: First Playwright click on mira-yes-btn (with force=True) did not fire the onClick — required a JS click to open the modal. Might be caused by the 'hover:-translate-y-0.5' transform shifting hitbox during the click frame, or an overlapping animated element (mira-avatar sparks/orbit) with pointer events. Real users click without issue in manual testing, but consider adding 'pointer-events: none' to decorative animation layers.
